description: มุน 2026-07-29 (calendar Phase 5): the save sheet (Figma 375:13316) + saved state (375:16355) — the 'เพิ่มลงปฏิทิน' CTA opens a slide-up sheet to pick ยาม + destinations + note; commit flips the menu 2→3 and grows the reminder list. The sheet is a MASK over goo's save-flow.ts machine — the page binds every field to useReminderDraft (toggleYam/toggleDest/setNote), the save button's disabled is goo's canCommit (NOT a hand guard), and the page adds ZERO useState of its own (menu state is DERIVED: sheetOpen ? draft.menuState(FormMode 4) : menuStateForDay(saved)). Bug-class the anchor owns (the PR#97-class WRITE-surface trap): this is the FIRST day-detail screen that writes state, so mapping only the happy path is exactly what looped PR#97 six times → the anchor drives the machine THROUGH THE UI and proves BOTH outcomes + the replay guard, not just success: (a) SUCCESS — tick 2 ยาม → บันทึก → sheet closed + reminder-count==2 + menu state 3 (Mate AI back); (b) CANCEL — backdrop → sheet gone + reminder-count STILL 0 + menu stays 2 (draft discarded, no ghost save); (c) NO-OP/replay guard — fire บันทึก x3 SYNCHRONOUSLY (one JS tick, before React re-renders) → reminder-count==1 not 3 (goo's transition-table latch: commit is a no-op once 'saving' + reminders.add de-dupes by id); (d) commit guard — save DISABLED with 0 ยาม via canCommit; (e) FormMode(4) hides Mate AI while sheet open. no-regress (บทเรียน #130): the base sections + C+ #374151 + 0 overflow + 0 anim survive open→close, AND anchor 3a + anchor 3b were RE-RUN green (the write-surface adds behaviour without distorting the read-only screens). done-condition proven with goo's shared trackAppFetches (0 app-fetch, no BE). reminders are per-page client state (goo's useReminders, not persisted this phase) so the anchor proves count via an on-page data-testid=reminder-count (navigating to the list page would reset the mock). Teeth mut-nonidempotent-save (mint a unique id per click to bypass de-dup) → the no-op guard reads 3 not 1 → CAUGHT. screenshot sheet-open (375:13316) + saved (375:16355) @393 vs Figma. gate_layer=visual/state-machine-write-surface. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-calendar-save.ts#mut-nonidempotent-save
